description: Defines classes and types for managing datagram buffers, including a pool allocator and buffer handling for network I/O in the Chromium project.

classes.name: DatagramBuffer
classes.description: Represents a network datagram buffer with methods for data access and management.

classes.name: DatagramBufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of datagram buffers for efficient reuse and allocation.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds a copy of a buffer to the pool, associating it with a list of buffers.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Returns all buffers from a list back to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: max_buffer_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum buffer size allowed in the pool.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer data.
